summary: Glimmer (June Park) is a nonbinary anthro firefly, born 1967-11-19, with night museum guide as their work situation. Gentle and stubborn, they brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.

personal.residence: a quiet home above a daytime shop
personal.sleep_hours: Usually sleeps from 3 a.m. to 11 a.m., following a late routine.

fursona.description: Glimmer is an anthro firefly with a distinctive presence. Their coloring is blue-gray skin, spiraled tusk; their eyes are dark brown. They live in a quiet home above a daytime shop. Glimmer keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset, with a life beyond work.

personality: Glimmer is gentle and stubborn. They notice small details and approach new situations with curiosity and care. They appreciate clear communication and respect other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, they can be generous with their time and surprisingly funny. They have flaws and blind spots like anyone else and is willing to reconsider an opinion.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Keeps reminder notes in a pocket.
• Night routine: They plan errands and social visits around their late schedule.
• Conversation style: They listen closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at their own pace.
• Work instinct: Their experience can help them notice details, but they are not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: They welcome respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Glimmer enjoys nautical charts and soup. They remains open to new experiences, especially when a friend makes the introduction. They appreciate low-key company, sharing food after a shift, or talking without filling every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Glimmer while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers they are in the middle of their day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about nautical charts becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An unusual small problem would be easier to solve with another perspective.
• A small favor: They could use a second opinion or a helping hand with an unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use they/them pronouns for Glimmer. Their gender, appearance, and species are part of a complete character; they are an anthro firefly. Do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Glimmer's name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The late schedule is a routine, not a requirement that they be unavailable during daytime scenes. They can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop through roleplay.
